questions.prompt: Which fold is a clear mistake at 100bb?

choices.text: Folding A5s to a tight 4-bet after you used it as a bluff

questions.explanation: Kings continue. The other folds are reasonable.

questions.prompt: QQ versus a tight under-the-gun 4-bet all-in at 100bb is…

choices.text: An automatic joyous call with no thought
A close spot. Against a range that is only AA and KK, queens are behind.
A required fold every time, including against a loose button

questions.explanation: Who jammed matters. A nit’s UTG jam is heavier than a button’s. Do not use one rule for both.

choices.text: Be a min-click that invites six callers
Leave you a real decision, or commit you on purpose with the hands that want it

questions.explanation: A tiny 4-bet gives the 3-bettor a cheap call. A size that commits the stack is for value, not for A5s.

questions.prompt: Short-stacked (about 15–20bb), a small open that you will hate folding is often replaced by…

choices.text: A raise-all-in or a fold, because there is no room for postflop play

questions.explanation: When the remaining stack is only a few bets, decide preflop instead of open-folding a committed hand.
